title: Repeat the words you want to believe
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What do you tell yourself before the start?
Jose said that he learned to repeat to himself: I am confident, I will train hard, I will go to the state meet. He learned repetition, because in swimming you follow the black line up and down.
He said that you can repeat words like a rhythm so that they become the voice you hear instead of the old one.
Write the three sentences you will repeat each morning and where you will say them.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write where you will say them.
Write the old sentence they replace.
Write how long you will do it.
Write who will check on you.

check.q: What did Jose learn to do in swimming?
What did he say repetition replaces?
Where did he say you follow a black line?

recap: Repeat the words you want to believe.
